brief:
The UN agency for Palestinian refugees has identified 18 emergency shelters in Gaza requiring urgent repairs as winter approaches, according to Middle East Eye. Four of the facilities face very high risk of collapse, the agency said.

Unrwa did not specify the number of people sheltering in the at-risk facilities or detail the repairs needed to make them safe for the cold months ahead.
dek: Unrwa says 18 Gaza shelters require urgent attention as winter nears The UN agency for Palestinian refugees (Unrwa) has said that 18 of its emergency shelters in Gaza are unsafe as winter approaches, with four at very high risk of collapse.
title: UN agency warns 18 Gaza shelters unsafe as winter nears
